visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a black sleeveless turtleneck and a silver necklace, stands in front of a white closet. She speaks enthusiastically, gesturing with her hands and pointing upward while looking directly at the camera in a bright indoor studio setting. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of a black glass bottle labeled 'Lancôme Génifique Ultimate' held by a hand with white-painted nails. The background is a blurred domestic scene with neutral lighting. (3) A dropper is used to apply a clear, viscous liquid onto a hand; the liquid is then spread smoothly across the skin, highlighting its texture. The camera stays in a macro close-up focus on the hand movements and product consistency. (4) The woman reappears, holding the Lancôme bottle and pointing to her cheek. Her expression is cheerful as she demonstrates the product's effect. The background remains the white closet in soft indoor lighting. (5) A close-up reveals a square frosted glass bottle of 'Shu Uemura Unlimited' foundation. A beige liquid swatch is shown on a hand, followed by the woman applying the foundation to her face using a brush and a sponge. (6) A split-screen displays 'After' on the left and 'Before' on the right, showing the makeup finish on her face. She turns her head to show the glow and coverage under bright studio lights. (7) The woman holds a large black and gold jar of 'Kérastase Chronologiste' hair mask. She gestures toward her hair, which is styled in a short, sleek bob with highlights, while speaking about its benefits. (8) Close-ups show a finger scooping white cream from the jar and a comparison of hair texture before and after application. The woman concludes the video by pointing to a collection of the three products on a decorative shelf, smiling at the camera.
